title: Manager at Cloud Infrastructure Provider Expects Micron Demand to Rise 24% in 2026 Amid AI Growth
expert: Senior materials manager for memory, NAND and HDD at a global cloud infrastructure provider (current); Micron 25%-40% of memory spend
verdict: A cloud provider's memory buyer raised Micron spend 20% y/y in Sept–Nov 2026 at prices 5%–10% higher, with 95%–96% fill rates and ~90% of volume under 2–3 year LTAs, but is sending upside volume to Samsung and SK hynix.

Spot vs contract DRAM pricing: 🟡 Prices paid +5%–10% y/y, pace moderating under LTAs (first-hand), far below Cleveland's C4Q contract DRAM +15–20% q/q (SB #62062): conflicting; LTA pricing lags the market. → Tenet 4 (pricing durable, RoC peaked) ↓
SCA coverage %: 🟢 ~90% of volume under 2–3 year LTAs, 100% of HBM (first-hand) vs ex-Samsung SVP's LTAs at 80–90% of server DRAM contracts (SB #62239): consistent. → Tenet 3 (SCAs) ↑
Supply & lead times: 🟢 Fill rates 95%–96%, lead time ~4 weeks, inventory under 2 weeks (first-hand) vs TrendForce DRAM lead times 19 weeks (SB #65604): LTA buyers well served. → Tenet 1 (supply short) →
🟢 Micron spend +20% y/y Sept–Nov; demand +24% in 2026 and +28%–29% in 2027 (estimate). → Tenet 2 (AI demand) ↑
HBM4E share + 2027 HBM pricing round: 🔴 Samsung and SK hynix gaining share with supply outside LTAs and faster quality support (first-hand, unquantified), first read at this buyer. → Tenet 5 (HBM share) ↓

changes: Prices paid +5%–10% y/y vs Cleveland's C4Q contract DRAM +15–20% q/q (SB #62062, 2026-10-27): conflicting; LTA pricing lagging.
LTA coverage ~90% of volume (100% HBM) vs ex-Samsung SVP's 80–90% of server DRAM contracts (SB #62239, 2026-10-22): consistent.
Lead time ~4 weeks vs TrendForce DRAM lead times 19 weeks (SB #65604, 2026-11-02): far shorter for this LTA buyer.
Share shift to Samsung/SK hynix: first read at buyer level; no earlier expert call on this page before 2026-11-05.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (supply short through 2028): → — 95%–96% fill rates and ~4-week lead times for an LTA buyer; NAND most constrained, DDR5 slightly.
Tenet 2 (AI demand outruns supply): ↑ — spend +20% y/y; demand +24% in 2026 and +28%–29% in 2027 (estimate).
Tenet 3 (SCAs): ↑ — ~90% of volume under 2–3 year LTAs, 100% of HBM.
Tenet 4 (pricing durable, RoC peaked): ↓ — only +5%–10% y/y under LTAs, pace moderating.
Tenet 5 (HBM share): ↓ — Samsung and SK hynix gaining on supply outside LTAs.
